categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Forever Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the software and information technology services industry, focusing on BIM (Building Information Modeling) platform software and industry digital application services. Its business is structured into five main segments: BIM platform and software development, BIM-based intelligent design consulting, BIM-based industry digital twin applications, energy big data analysis and value-added services, and digital education. The company serves infrastructure sectors including power, transportation, and water conservancy, providing software products, design consulting, digital twin solutions, and energy data services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent R&D and proprietary core technologies, including 3D modeling engines (DH3D), 3D digital earth platforms (DHGlobe), AI platforms (AI-Engine), GIM engine platforms, IoT platforms, and BIMWise digital engineering lifecycle platforms. It employs integrated product development (IPD) methodologies, focusing on platform-based development that supports deep customization and secondary development. The company also integrates AI, GIS, IoT, and edge computing technologies, and pursues full localization of its platforms on domestic chips and operating systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily power grid companies and their subsidiaries, with additional clients in transportation, water conservancy, and new infrastructure sectors such as data centers. The company’s products and services support electric power transmission and distribution, renewable energy projects (solar, wind, energy storage), smart grids, intelligent transportation systems, and smart water management. It also serves industrial parks, public buildings, and overseas markets, notably in Africa through digital education initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant market presence in regions including North China, Northeast, East China, Northwest, Southwest, Central China, and South China. It also has overseas operations, including subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Rwanda. The company maintains a nationwide sales and service network through multiple branch offices and subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Forever Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and digital services supply chain. It develops and sells proprietary BIM software platforms and tools, provides intelligent design consulting, and delivers integrated digital solutions and services to infrastructure operators and project developers. It also engages in system integration and comprehensive energy service provision, positioning itself as a full lifecycle digital solution provider rather than a raw material or hardware supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing its BIM platform software and expanding industry digital applications, emphasizing independent and controllable core technology development. It prioritizes AI integration, localization of software on domestic hardware and operating systems, and the expansion of digital twin and smart infrastructure solutions. R&D efforts target intelligent design tools, energy big data analytics, AI-powered automation, and cross-industry software applications. The company also invests in digital education to support overseas market development and talent cultivation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, technical and design consulting services, system integration projects, licensing of proprietary software, and value-added energy data services. The company also earns income from BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) projects in energy infrastructure and digital education services. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales channels, tenders, and negotiated contracts with large infrastructure clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic BIM software market for power grid engineering, with a market share exceeding 50% in 3D transmission line design software. It is among the few domestic firms capable of providing a full suite of BIM applications across power transmission, distribution, and renewable energy sectors. Its integrated service model combining software and consulting differentiates it from competitors, supported by strong proprietary technology and extensive industry certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 956.57 million, representing a 15.42% increase from 2023. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 157.74 million, primarily due to increased project costs and market challenges. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 2.32 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 1.86 billion. The company maintains a significant R&D investment, accounting for over 8% of revenue, reflecting its growth and innovation focus despite recent profitability pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its independently developed, fully controllable BIM core technology platforms that enable deep customization and integration across infrastructure project lifecycles. Its unique value lies in providing comprehensive, one-stop digital solutions combining software, intelligent design consulting, digital twin applications, and energy big data analytics tailored to power, transportation, and water sectors. The integration of AI and localization on domestic platforms further differentiates its offerings, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and supporting national strategic initiatives such as digital economy, carbon neutrality, and smart infrastructure development.
